title: Smart import
body: Screenshots, photos, PDFs, Excel or Word. Nothing is added until you check it.
drop: Drop files here, or paste a screenshot
privacy: Your files are sent to Anthropic to be read, and aren't kept.
sharedCheck: Didn't share these? Close this, and nothing is read or kept.
sharedGone: The shared files are no longer here. Share them again.
whose: Whose spending and income is this?
whoseHint: Where a file shows whose it is, that's filled in for you. The rest is added for whoever you pick here.
noteLabel: Anything we should know about these files?
notePlaceholder: e.g. These are all my Max card transactions for September
noteHint: Optional. It helps the reader; what the files show always comes first.

refused.too_large: Too large to read: 15 MB at most, 10 MB for a PDF.
refused.pdf_password: This PDF is password-protected. Open it, save or print an unprotected copy, and add that.
refused.pdf_pages: More than 100 pages. Split it first.
refused.word97: Word 97 files can't be read. Save it as .docx.
refused.unsupported: This kind of file can't be read.

error.offline: You're offline. Your files are still here.
error.quota: You've reached today's limit. Try again tomorrow, or add it yourself.
error.not_configured: Reading files isn't set up yet.
error.timeout: Reading took too long. Try fewer files at once.
error.too_large: Too much to read at once. Try fewer files.
error.partial: Only part of this document could be read.
error.unauthorized: Sign in again to read files.

nothing: We didn't find any transactions, cards or bank accounts in these files.
totals: This statement's total is <total></total>; the rows found add up to <sum></sum>.

flag.amount_unreadable: Check the amount: it couldn't be read.
flag.date_unreadable: Check the date: it couldn't be read.
flag.amount_not_in_source: Check the amount: it isn't in the file.
flag.date_out_of_range: Check the date: it looks wrong.
flag.reads_disagree: Check it: read twice, it came out differently.
flag.one_read_only: Check it: only one of two reads found it.
flag.pending: Still pending, so it may change.
flag.card_fee_counted: Already counted as the card fee.
flag.total_estimated: Plan total worked out from the payment.
flag.total_mismatch: Check it: the statement's total doesn't match.
flag.not_saveable: Something is missing. Open it to finish.
flag.rate_missing: No exchange rate for this date.
flag.cash_withdrawal: Cash withdrawal: not counted as an expense. You can record it in the Cash tab.

noRate_one: 1 left out: no exchange rate for its date.
noRate_other: {{count}} left out: no exchange rate for their dates.
saveFailed: Couldn't add them. Nothing was changed.

method.known: Already added, nothing new in the file.

cardFlag.reads_disagree: Check it: read twice, it came out differently.
cardFlag.one_read_only: Check it: only one of two reads found it.
cardFlag.not_in_source: Check it: some of it isn't in the file.
cardFlag.card_known: Already added, nothing new in the file.

fillBody: Filled in from your file. Add what it didn't show: {{fields}}.
fillCheck: Filled in from your file. Check it, then save.

unfinished.body: Your files showed only part of these. They stay here until you fill in the rest or delete them.
unfinished.waiting_one: 1 card or account is still to finish. It's waiting in Smart import.
unfinished.waiting_other: {{count}} cards and accounts are still to finish. They're waiting in Smart import.
